profile.headline: iOS Software Engineer | Software Engineering Manager | Leading Cross-Functional Teams | People-First Leader | AI-Driven Performance Booster
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer with 18 years of experience, including 13+ years in mobile development and over 4 years leading multi-platform teams as an Engineering Manager. I specialize in iOS engineering, architecture, and the delivery of large-scale consumer applications across iOS, Android, and Web platforms.

In recent years, I’ve operated as a Principal iOS Engineer and Engineering Manager, providing strategic oversight and hands-on leadership for high-impact projects like Disney Parks’ mobile commerce and real-time guest experience features. My approach balances technical direction with mentoring, cross-functional collaboration, and a commitment to engineering quality and scalability.

I’ve built and maintained balanced team structures, optimized for delivery, career growth, and cost. I actively foster psychological safety, encourage open feedback, and support engineers in becoming subject-matter experts and trusted leaders in their own right.

More recently, I've deepened my practice around AI-assisted engineering workflows. I orchestrate complex observability and feature delivery systems using structured AI pipelines (brainstorm→spec→plan→execute→review), seamlessly integrating enterprise tools (Splunk, Jira, Grafana, Zephyr) as a coordination layer. I diagnose production root causes by synthesizing logs, metrics, and code evidence—turning 200+ observability queries into actionable hypotheses. I've also standardized my own engineering practices through automation, custom verification hooks, and pragmatic fallback patterns when tooling fails, treating AI infrastructure with the same rigor as production code.

My background includes early experience as a Java developer, giving me a strong foundation in backend systems, RESTful APIs, and full-stack communication—skills I now use to build better client-side integrations and architecture.

I’m passionate about building inclusive teams, driving continuous improvement, and delivering user-centric solutions that scale globally.

Skills: Swift, UIKit, Objective-C, Combine, Angular, Node.js, Javascript, Tech Leadership
Patterns: Dependency Management (CocoaPods, Carthage, Swift Package Manager, NPM, Gradle), CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab Pipelines, Fastlane), Realtime DBs (CouchBase, Firebase), Architecture Patterns (MVVM, MVVM-C, Clean Architecture, VIPER), Reactive Programming (Combine, Streams), Static Code Analysis (Linters, SonarQube), Declarative UI (SwiftUI, Flutter), Imperative UI(UIKit), Protocols/APIs (HTTP/HTTPs, REST, GraphQ), SQL/NoSQL, Performance profiling

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built iOS Realtime Metrics observability pipeline — Designed production monitoring system (Grafana dashboards, alert definitions, PromQL queries) enabling rapid multi-signal root cause diagnostics. Reduced debugging cycles from hours to minutes through iterative query refinement.
- Designed and implemented AxonOpenTelemetry iOS shared package — Built SDK enabling standardized metric collection and export across ADM, Device Checkout, and Fleet3 apps. Migrated observability from log-centric (Splunk) to OpenTelemetry metrics compliant with M&T pipeline constraints (payload size, upload frequency). Integrated with PCG (Prometheus/Grafana) for real-time monitoring and MTTD alerting across Connected Devices pillar.
positions.insights: Skills: Claude Skills · AI-Assisted Workflow & Observability Expertise · Agentic AI Development · AI Assisted Coding · AI Pair Programming / AI-Assisted Programming · Custom AI Skills

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
- Led a cross-functional team of 20+ engineers across iOS, Android, and Web, supporting features used by millions.
- Built a balanced team structure that improved delivery efficiency and led to an 8–10% margin increase over 2 years.
- Fostered a culture of psychological safety and ownership, resulting in 0 attrition and high engagement during peak cycles.
- Boosted team velocity by ~20% through TDD, better code review practices, and delivery process improvements.
- Scaled client engagement by 80% by integrating engineering leadership into strategic roadmap planning.
- Improved onboarding, reducing ramp-up time for new engineers by ~30% through pairing and documentation.
- Partnered with product and design leads to ensure on-time delivery of seasonal, high-traffic initiatives.
- Helped 3 engineers step into tech lead roles and positioned others as trusted SMEs in client-facing initiatives.

positions.title: Principal iOS Engineer
positions.description:
- Led architecture and delivery of key app features, improving onboarding by 30%, delivery speed by 20%, and reducing regressions by 25%.
- Built real-time content sync using Couchbase, cutting update latency from 10+ minutes to near-instant across millions of users.
- Delivered dynamic ticket pricing system with real-time updates, reducing drop-off by improving transparency and responsiveness.
- Rolled out Mobile Merchandise Checkout, cutting in-store wait times from 90+ minutes to under 10 at peak Disney retail locations.
- Shipped Mobile Food & Beverage Ordering, reducing guest wait times from 30–45 minutes to 5–10 via in-app pickup.
- Advocated for TDD and implemented testing practices, reducing QA-found bugs by 30% and improving release confidence.

positions.title: Principal Mobile Engineer | Tech Lead
positions.description:
- Hands-on lead for multi-platform teams of 10+ engineers (iOS, Android, Web, Services) and coordinated estimation, design, implementation, and go-live phases for high-visibility Commerce vertical features (Tickets and Annual Passes sales and Dynamic Pricing support)
- Leading and mentoring diverse teams of developers by providing technical direction, encouraging best practices in Mobile development, Unit Testing, Performance, and fostering an environment of collaboration and innovation.

positions.title: Senior iOS Engineer | Tech Lead
positions.description:
- Spearheaded the development of a dynamic ticket pricing system that provided real-time updates, reducing purchase abandonment through timely, demand-driven pricing information.  
- Launched Mobile Merchandise Checkout, cutting checkout times from over 90 minutes to under 10 minutes.  
- Led the development of the iOS Wallet and Payment flow for the Adaptive Payment Platform SDK used within Shop Disney Parks flow of the My Disney Experience application.
- Mentored a team of 10+ iOS and Android developers, enhancing collaboration and skill development within the Commerce vertical.

positions.title: Senior iOS Engineer | Tech Lead
positions.description:
- I introduced real-time update capabilities using Couchbase, reducing content sync times from over 10 minutes to near-instant updates for millions of users. 
- Championed Disney’s Mobile Ordering feature for food & beverage in the My Disney Experience app, enabling guests to bypass traditional queues and cut wait times from 30–45 minutes (or more during peak hours) to as low as 5–10 minutes.

positions.title: Principal Mobile Engineer
positions.description:
- Established and scaled Pragma's Mobile Development division, leading all mobile initiatives across clients and overseeing both native and hybrid app development. 
- Directed the development of hybrid mobile applications for top financial entities using IBM MobileFirst and AngularJS/Ionic Framework. 
- Successfully orchestrated the end-to-end development and launch of Nequi, Colombia's inaugural digital-only banking app, achieving over 20 million active users to date.
positions.insights: Skills: Imperative Programming · UIKit · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Mobile Architecture · Dependency Management · Coaching & Mentoring · Team Leadership · FinTech · Software Design Patterns

positions.title: Staff Mobile Engineer
positions.description:
- Led the design and deployment of AVON's sales support applications for iPad/iPhone and hybrid Android/Windows Phone platforms, optimizing the sales experience across Latin America.
- Developed and released  the Canvas Model Design Application on the Apple App Store, allowing users to develop various business model strategies. (https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/canvas-model-design-build/id568186908?mt=8)
Developed and launched  the Brainstorming Canvas Application on the Apple App Store to assist in brainstorming efforts. (https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/brainstorming-canvas-generating/id616328661)
- Managed the development of a specialized iPhone app for Farmacias Similares, facilitating the franchise's audit operations in Mexico for over 9,500 locations across all 32 Mexican states.
- Championed the development of the Pac SUFI iPad application for Bancolombia's sales force, supported by a Ruby on Rails backend for Colombia's premier car show.
- Innovated the Sura EPS and ARL Sura apps, including an RSS reader for up-to-date content and a WebRTC app for remote assistance with work risks. (https://itunes.apple.com/co/app/asesor-en-linea-arl-sura/id890698366?mt=8)
positions.insights: Skills: Imperative Programming · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · JavaScript · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · iOS development · Objective-C
